text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ministry of Culture and Information urges poets to write poems to celebrate President Saddam's 60th birthday on March 28.
- United States is target of condemnation on both Arab and international levels for its Iraq policy.
- American industrialists say sanctions have had adverse impact on U.S. economy.
- Deputy Prime Minister Aziz, in Russia, says Moscow adopts positive stands on Iraq sanctions.
- Iraq protests against violation of its territorial waters by Kuwaiti boat.
- Kuwaiti Crown Prince in hospital amid tight security.
- President Saddam's envoy meets Sudanese president in Khartoum.
- British Moslems denounce sanctions on Iraq.
(The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ and QADISSIYA)
- Editorial attacks U.N. arms envoy Ekeus.
- Commentary says Iraq's return to Arab fold is only way to force Israel to give up builidng activities in Jerusalem.
- Article on oppression and lack of freedoms in Iran.
